name: General Bipin Rawat
real_life_parallel: Army Chief 2016-2019; India's first CDS 2020-2021; killed December 2021 helicopter crash

biography.background: Army Chief during 2016 surgical strikes and Uri response. Became India's first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) in 2020. Killed in helicopter crash near Coonoor, Tamil Nadu, December 2021.
biography.military_philosophy: Muscular counter-terrorism; 'surgical strike' advocacy; integration of services
biography.film_relevance: Part 3: Surgical strikes, Balakot. Part 4: Death as emotional inflection point.

faction.primary: Indian Army → Chief of Defence Staff

death.circumstances: Mil Mi-17V5 helicopter crash near Coonoor; 13 killed including CDS, wife, staff
death.impact: Setback to CDS institutionalization; emotional resonance
